name: io.github.HYPD-AI/openai-ads-mcp
description: OpenAI Ads MCP: reads plus opt-in paused campaign, ad group, ad creation and preview.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI Ads API key (Bearer token), scoped to one ad account.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set true to expose paused creation, image URL upload and preview tools. Defaults to false. No activation tools.
